component.name: blurt
component.summary: A small, fast Mumble voice chat client

description.p: blurt is a native client for Mumble voice chat servers. It aims to be quick to start, light on memory and CPU, and to send clean, low-latency audio.

ul.li: Echo cancellation and RNNoise noise suppression
A voice gate that keeps bangs, typing and background noise off the air
Voice over encrypted UDP, falling back to TCP
Trust-on-first-use server certificates and a client certificate
Channel tree, chat, mute and deafen

description.p: First release: connect to servers, join channels, talk, listen and chat.
